summary: ASX fell -0.97% to 8,978.4 as a global bond sell-off and a US-Iran oil spike drove risk-off. Materials -3.08% and IT -3.35% led the decline and gold RS leaders pulled back. Australia's Q2 GDP beat (+2.1%) revived rate-hike risk ahead of the 29 Sep RBA. GNC +11.02% and insurers (IAG +5.46%) bucked the trend; KAO +151.7% on a copper discovery led the spec board.
